name: Da Vinci
kurzbeschreibung:
**Da Vinci in Füssen**

Discover the genius of Leonardo da Vinci in **Füssen**, where the legendary artist spent his final years. The **Haus der Geschichte** (House of History) invites you to explore the fascinating life and work of the Renaissance master in the very place where he created some of his most iconic sketches.

Stroll through the charming old town, where the **Schloss Neuschwanstein** looms majestically in the background, and imagine da Vinci sketching the breathtaking landscapes of the **Alps** and the **Ammergau**. The exhibition offers a unique blend of art, history, and the natural beauty of **Tirol**.

Don’t miss the chance to indulge in traditional **Tiroler** cuisine—try a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or a bowl of creamy **Käsespätzle** while reflecting on the masterpieces that once inspired da Vinci in this very region.

Plan your visit to **Füssen** and immerse yourself in the world of one of history’s greatest minds!
